usedFor: Superchat holds your messaging contacts, and Google Sheets stores each “Contact Created” as rows through “Add Multiple Rows”.

bestTemplate.name: “Contact Created” in Superchat, then “Add Multiple Rows” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: New contacts collect in a sheet you can sort and share, with one or several rows added per run.

watchOut: “Add Multiple Rows” takes data by column or as a JSON array, so match your sheet to the contact's data.
